message: Last winter, I thought I’d be clever and stock up on snacks before the big snowstorm. I ended up with a mountain of gummy bears and a can of chili that expired in 2018. As the winds howled outside, I found myself wondering, ‘Why didn’t I think to grab some actual food?’ The silver lining? I had enough sugar to last through the apocalypse! Lesson learned: a little planning goes a long way, even if it’s just for the sake of your taste buds. What’s the most unusual item you’ve ever prepped for a storm?
